summary: Configured node1 with an authenticated SMB share named projects. Node2 can list, read, create, and update documents as designer. Guest, anonymous, sibling-share, and parent-traversal access are rejected. Original drawings remain checksum-identical. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were retained.
actions_performed: Installed Samba server components on node1 and client components on node2.
Configured projects as the only SMB share, restricted to designer and node2.
Applied persistent SELinux labels, firewall access, service enablement, and design-team filesystem permissions.
Verified authenticated listing, reading, creation, overwrite, and readback from node2.
Verified guest, anonymous, sibling-share, sibling-file, and directory-traversal rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually using native systemd reboot scheduling, polling each until its boot identity changed and health recovered.

evidence.requirement: projects SMB share configured securely on node1
evidence.summary: Samba configuration validates; only projects is exported with designer-only access, SMB2 minimum, persistent SELinux labeling, firewall access, and enabled service.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
evidence.summary: Direct SMB operations listed and read existing files, created and overwrote a document, and confirmed the final updated content on node1.
Guest and anonymous tree connections were denied; the private sibling share was absent; parent traversal and sibling-file fetch both failed without creating a local file.
Pre-change and final SHA-256 hashes match for drawing.txt and materials.csv.
Both nodes remained on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4d842549-003e-4f78-bb26-12732f129e58, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 310640c6-22bc-4658-8afb-c6b1e4fe8aef, active Samba service, intact data, and successful post-restart remote read/write.
